title: Determine Distance on the Coordinate Plane
objective: I can find the distance between two points on the coordinate plane using absolute value.
model: coordinate plane with two points on one row or column; distance = |x1 − x2| or |y1 − y2| (subtract absolute values on the same side of 0, add across 0)

widgets.component: warm-up: quadrant of (−4, 5), point on the x-axis, quadrant for +x, −y
widgets.root: Identical to the lesson's warm-up and reviews 7-5; keys Quadrant II, (4, 0), Quadrant IV verified.

widgets.component: distance (−4, 3)-(2, 3) and (5, −2)-(5, 4), rectangle perimeter, four-pair distance table, 'add absolute values when both are on the same side' error
widgets.root: Distances 6, 6, perimeter 14 and table 8, 10, 6, 5 recomputed; the error's wrong step is e=1 (adding when both positions are positive). The perimeter-from-vertices item previews 7-7 but uses only the 7-6 distance rule plus prior-grade perimeter.

widgets.component: rectangle width, height, perimeter table; distances across and along axes; subtract-instead-of-add error
widgets.root: Table 7/4/22 and 8/6/28, distances 12, 5, 7 and the 8 vs 2 error (|−5| + |3|) recomputed; error step e=1 is the first wrong step.

widgets.component: generated: units between A and B read from a drawn plane or computed from coordinates; two-leg trips
widgets.root: Ran 250 seeds x 4 levels: A and B are plotted at the stated coordinates, share a row or column, and the keyed distance (and two-leg trip total) equals the plotted segments in every figure; no point outside the frame.

widgets.where: Practice 4.7; Challenge 3.1-3.2 (act:plot mode distance L2, L3, L4)
widgets.component: plot the point d units from A along its row or column (both points at L3-L4, half-units at L4)
widgets.root: The model is right (counted grid units, crossing 0 handled, 'measured from the origin' trap named). It is the inverse of the lesson's task (given the distance, place the point), so it never asks the student to read a distance off two points; Challenge §1 supplies that.

Connect check without its scenario (drone (−4, 0) → (3, 0) → (3, −5)). The stem names no points; the two legs exist only in 5.1 and 5.2, so 5.3 is answerable only by remembering the previous two items and adding 7 + 5.
widgets.replacement: Make the three items one set with the figure: viz {t:'coord', points:[(−4,0),(3,0),(3,−5)], segments:[[0,1],[1,2]]} and the stem 'A drone flies (−4, 0) → (3, 0) → (3, −5). How long is the whole flight path?'. Keep 12 with distractors 2 (7 − 5), 7 and 35.

widgets.component: horizontal and vertical legs, (3, −2)-(3, 5), (0, −8)-(0, 5), pair exactly 6 apart
widgets.root: Keys 7, 5, 7, 13 and pair (−2, 5)/(4, 5) verified; the other three pairs are 7, 3 and 7 apart.

widgets.component: generated distances across 0, trips, and solve-for-x on a shared row
widgets.root: Same generator checks as Practice §4; L4 samples recomputed ((−6, 7) + 10 right gives x = 4; Q in Quadrant III at distance 6 from (5, −7) gives x = −1; 4 below (−4, −3) gives y = −7).

widgets.component: distance error, rectangle written task, perimeter, hose path on a drawn plane, same-side/opposite-side table, fence around a drawn bed, bush count along a row
widgets.root: Recomputed: hose Tomato (−4, 3) → Herb (5, 3) → Pepper (5, −2) = 9 + 5 = 14; table 9/opposite, 4/same, 10/opposite; fence 24 ft; 12 bushes (inclusive count). The written task's square gives length 7, width 7, perimeter 28, area 49.

widgets.component: sort pairs by add vs subtract; three error analyses; three gardeners; 13 units, 8 units, 8-unit pair on a drawn plane, herb bed area 56, other scarecrow (5, 7)
widgets.root: Sort bins (add across 0, subtract on one side) and error steps (e=1, 1, 1) verified; P/Q are 8 apart on the drawn plane; area 8 x 7 = 56.

typography: Practice 1.1-1.2, 2.1-2.5, 3.1-3.3, 3.5, 5.4 and Challenge 2.1, 2.2 print negative coordinates with an ASCII hyphen-minus ((-4, 3), 'x = -3'); the error-analysis texts in 2.5, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4 and Challenge 2.1, 2.3 use a hyphen as the subtraction sign ('5 - 3 = 2'). §5.1-5.3 and all generated items use U+2212.
